stopPoints.label: Peppa and her family are driving in their car
stopPoints.question:
Question (Destination): 'Where is Peppa's family driving to?'
Options: 'A) To the mountains 🏔️
B) To the beach 🏖️'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'To the mountains!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig talks about his favourite colour
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'Daddy Pig loves this colour. What is his favourite colour?'
Options: 'A) Green 🍏
B) Pink 🌸'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Green! His favourite colour is green!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig talks about her favourite colour
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'What is Mummy Pig's favourite colour?'
Options: 'A) Orange 🍊
B) Purple 🍇'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Orange!'

stopPoints.label: George smiles and says his favourite colour
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'What is George's favourite colour?'
Options: 'A) Blue 🌊
B) Yellow ☀️'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Blue!'

stopPoints.label: Candy Cat drives by in her green car
stopPoints.question:
Question (Vehicle & Color): 'Look at Candy Cat's car! What colour is it?'
Options: 'A) Green 🚗
B) Red 🚗'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'It is green!'

stopPoints.label: Danny Dog arrives in Granddad Dog's breakdown truck
stopPoints.question:
Question (Color): 'What colour is the big breakdown truck?'
Options: 'A) Orange 🚚
B) Blue 🚚'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'It is orange! Mummy Pig wins!'

stopPoints.label: Suzy Sheep arrives in a blue car
stopPoints.question:
Question (Animal & Friend): 'Who is in the blue car with Mummy Sheep?'
Options: 'A) Suzy Sheep 🐑
B) Pedro Pony 🐴'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Suzy Sheep!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa looks sad because she hasn't seen a red car
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'How does Peppa feel now?'
Options: 'A) Sad 😢
B) Happy 😊'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'She feels sad.'

stopPoints.label: Peppa realizes their own car is red
stopPoints.question:
Question (Observation): 'What colour is Peppa's family car?'
Options: 'A) Red 🚗
B) Black 🚗'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'It is red! Peppa wins!'

stopPoints.label: The family arrives at the mountaintop and it starts raining
stopPoints.question:
Question (Weather): 'Oh dear! What is the weather like now?'
Options: 'A) It is rainy 🌧️
B) It is snowy ❄️'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'It is rainy! It has started to rain!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig points towards Miss Rabbit's ice cream stall
stopPoints.question:
Question (Food): 'What delicious food is Miss Rabbit selling?'
Options: 'A) Ice cream 🍦
B) Pizza 🍕'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Ice cream!'

stopPoints.label: Miss Rabbit hands four ice creams to Daddy Pig
stopPoints.question:
Question (Counting): 'How many ice creams does Daddy Pig buy for the family?'
Options: 'A) 4 ice creams 🍦
B) 2 ice creams 🍦'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Four ice creams!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa shows her ice cream flavour
stopPoints.question:
Question (Flavor & Color): 'What flavour and colour is Peppa's ice cream?'
Options: 'A) Strawberry red 🍓
B) Chocolate brown 🍫'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Strawberry red!'

stopPoints.label: A beautiful rainbow appears across the sky
stopPoints.question:
Question (Nature): 'Look at the sky! What came out after the rain?'
Options: 'A) A rainbow 🌈
B) A moon 🌙'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'A rainbow!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig explains when rainbows appear
stopPoints.question:
Question (Science & Weather): 'When does a rainbow appear?'
Options: 'A) When it is rainy and sunny at the same time 🌦️
B) When it is night time 🌌'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Rainy and sunny at the same time!'

stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig tells them what is at the end of a rainbow
stopPoints.question:
Question (Story): 'What do you find at the end of a rainbow?'
Options: 'A) Treasure 💎
B) Books 📚'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Treasure!'

stopPoints.label: The rainbow is gone and George cries
stopPoints.question:
Question (Emotion): 'Why is George crying?'
Options: 'A) The rainbow is gone 😢
B) He dropped his ice cream 🍦'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'Because the rainbow is gone!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig finds a big muddy puddle
stopPoints.question:
Question (Action & Fun): 'What is the rainbow treasure?'
Options: 'A) A big muddy puddle! 🥾
B) A box of gold 🪙'
Guidance: Encourage the child to say: 'A big muddy puddle!'
